adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `admin-embedding` controller, `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({});` and does not attach any `.then`/`.catch` (unlike `embeddable-host` component which uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)` on save). If `update()` returns a promise (as typical for REST-backed model updates in this codebase), a rejected save would have no local error handling or user feedback here, making failures easy to miss. The diff doesn’t show whether `update()` is globally handled, so this is a concrete robustness/UX issue rather than a provable functional break.
